The technology has proven capable of identifying potential tornado activity 15 to 30 minutes in advance, giving emergency responders and communities more time to act. content: Pemetaan Real-Time Atmosfer yang Tak Terlihat Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) mewakili lini depan dalam teknologi pemprofilan atmosfer.
